In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is not a single method of measuring spinal curvature which is superior to any other.
the most effective and reliable methods of postural analysis are the radiography, Spinal Mouse and the MRI. These techniques are not easily applied and are not suitable for routine use.
the use of the PRF technique in postural assessment of the lumbosacral spine has been proven to be a reliable method for the evaluation of posture, with advantages over the traditional methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the methods of greater facility are: Photometry, the Postural Frame Technique (PPT), Force Platform, and Goniometry.
the methods that are most used and have greater ease of use are: Fotometry, the Postural Reference Frame Technique (PRF), Force Platform and Goniometry.
the most used techniques in the postural diagnosis of the spine are the ones with the lowest accuracy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of the Spinal Mouse in the assessment of the lumbar lordosis can be an effective and low-cost method to evaluate the posture of the patients with LBP.
the use of a combination of methods is recommended in order to achieve the most reliable and accurate results.
there are many different ways to measure the lumbar spine and that each method has advantages and disadvantages.
